words.nav.label: Developer links
words.index.title: ThoughtKnot for developers: libraries, graph format, builds
words.index.description: Docs for developers: the JavaScript and Python graph libraries, the versioned graph format spec and the newest nightly builds of ThoughtKnot.
words.index.heading: ThoughtKnot for developers
words.index.lede: Everything for reading, checking and building on ThoughtKnot graphs. Graphs are plain text. Two free libraries, in JavaScript and Python, give the same answers. This site shows the stable release. The nightly builds sit apart, for those who want the newest work.
words.index.libraries.title: The libraries
words.index.libraries.text: Read a graph, check it against the spec, and get its canonical hash, in JavaScript or Python.
words.index.spec.title: The graph format
words.index.spec.text: The versioned spec every graph obeys: {sections} sections, now at version {specVersion}.
words.index.nightly.title: Nightly builds
words.index.nightly.text: The newest builds from main, for testing. They may change or break.
words.libraries.title: Graph libraries: JavaScript and Python
words.libraries.description: The graph spec's library operations, with the JavaScript and Python name of each, and how a problem is reported.
words.libraries.heading: Graph libraries
words.libraries.lede: The JavaScript and Python libraries offer the same operations and give the same answers. A test holds both to the list below.
words.libraries.example: A first call in JavaScript, in ten lines
words.libraries.problem.title: How a problem is reported
words.libraries.problem.never: A problem code is never reused, so a code you stored always means what it meant.
words.spec.title: Graph format spec: version, sections and changes
words.spec.description: The versioned spec for ThoughtKnot graphs: its current version, what changed in each version, and its sections.
words.spec.heading: The graph format
words.spec.lede: The spec is a graph itself, with a section for each rule family. A change to the rules makes a new version, with the owner's approval. A reader of an older major version refuses a newer one.
words.spec.source: The spec's source, as a graph
words.spec.col.title: Title
words.nightly.title: Nightly builds of ThoughtKnot
words.nightly.description: The newest nightly builds of ThoughtKnot, made from main for testing.
words.nightly.heading: Nightly builds
words.nightly.lede: A nightly is built from main each night that main moved. It is for testing, and may change or break. Everyday users should stay on the stable release. This page is kept out of search engines.
words.nightly.none: No nightly builds are listed yet.
